subject: Engineering Careers
question: A student enjoys mathematics, programming, and logical problem solving and wants to work in software architecture and AI. Which branch aligns most closely with these interests?

explanation.why: CSE centers on algorithms, discrete math, software engineering, and machine learning foundations that directly power AI and software roles.
explanation.commonTrap: While other branches can learn coding as an elective, CSE makes computing core.

subject: Engineering Careers
question: A student wants to work in semiconductor processor design and loves digital electronics, Verilog/HDL, and computer architecture. Which branch and skill combination is most aligned?
options: ECE with digital logic design, VLSI systems, and computer architecture skills
Civil Engineering with surveying and concrete mix design
Biotechnology with fermentation and wet-lab genetics
Textile Engineering with weaving loom mechanics

explanation.why: Semiconductor VLSI roles demand strong digital electronics, hardware description languages (Verilog/VHDL), transistor physics, and computer architecture.
explanation.shortcut: Semiconductors + Digital Systems + Architecture = ECE + VLSI.
explanation.commonTrap: Application web development alone does not prepare you for silicon chip architecture.

subject: Engineering Careers
question: Which engineering career directly combines electronic hardware circuits with C/C++ programming on microcontrollers?

explanation.why: Embedded firmware engineers bridge hardware schematics, sensors, and real-time C/C++ or Rust code inside medical devices, satellites, EVs, and robots.
explanation.shortcut: Circuits + Microcontrollers + C/C++ = Embedded Systems Engineer.
explanation.commonTrap: Pure frontend web roles don't typically touch hardware registers or GPIO pins.

subject: Engineering Careers
question: Electric Vehicle (EV) engineering teams typically combine experts from which engineering branches? (Select all correct answers.)
options: Computer Science / ECE (autonomous software & embedded controllers)

explanation.why: Modern EVs are multi-disciplinary systems requiring electrical powertrains, mechanical thermal/structural design, and embedded/AI software.
explanation.shortcut: Select EEE + Mechanical + CSE/ECE; exclude non-engineering options.
explanation.commonTrap: Real industries rarely use just one branch—complex products combine multiple disciplines.
